name: Yaja
source:
A maid hired by Zi-Jin. She and her husband are always taking care of Wan's family. Though Yaja is kind and caring, Yu-Qing always treats her badly.

"Lady, congratulations. You made a friend."

[Edited from [url=http://www.erotes-studio.com/MayJasmine_english/03.html]official website[/url]]
